final_test_accounting: 95 full-run passes plus two repaired previously unsuccessful cases cover all 97 unique cases; the third targeted pass repeats duplicate-json. findings.remediation: Validator now independently rejects both pinned hashes; explicit resealing regression covers the context boundary.

findings.finding: Initial candidate numerical-parity test compared hashes and counts without comparing numerical metric rows.
findings.remediation: Test now captures accepted-scorer metrics.scores and compares exact rows for alternate, null and absent descriptive names.

findings.finding: Initial new orchestration matrix omitted malformed top-level data, body bounds, competing stable IDs, repeated provider IDs and rights-before-scoring checks.
findings.remediation: Expanded final matrix covers these boundaries and CLI malformed/missing/oversized/time/candidate paths.

findings.finding: An oversized bytes parameter became a roughly half-megabyte pytest node identifier, causing Windows setup and teardown errors and excessive collection output.
findings.remediation: Explicit duplicate-json and oversized-body test identifiers; both cases independently rerun successfully.

findings.finding: Initial ambiguous-club negative fixture assigned an identifier already belonging to the same home club, so it created valid evidence.
findings.remediation: Fixture now asserts distinct away-club names and assigns one away provider ID to both; independently rerun successfully.

findings.finding: Initial negative context resealing produced synthetic Pydantic serializer warnings because nested fixtures were dictionaries.
findings.remediation: Negative tests retain typed fixture objects; final run and remediation run had no reported serializer warnings.

implemented_defect_verified: Previously accepted bool/float linked global result IDs now fail exact integer checks before equality. The linked-ID change is the only modification to the legacy projector module.
policy_verdict: Separately versioned inactive synthetic candidate is defensible from retained nullable non-routing descriptive-name schema. Exact stable identifiers, strict legacy name policy, actual P01 context and forecast exclusions remain. Candidate acceptance and fresh one-shot A04 permission are absent.
release_gate_note: Independent AB review clearance is separate from final installed-wheel execution, complete repository acceptance, exact-SHA CI, publication binding and human acceptance. Private-engine changes are outside this review.
remaining_conditions: Live A03 mismatched field and value remain unknown; source final-result availability is not inferred.
Candidate metadata policy remains PROPOSED_UNAPPROVED and INACTIVE.
Actual A04 requires separate human decision, fresh one-shot controls and review/CI binding of its eventual implementation.
Synthetic checks establish engineering behaviour, not football forecast accuracy, calibration, model promotion or actual P01 evidence.
